facts.fact: Niger's Justice Ministry says the head of state signed Ordinance 2024-28 on 7 June 2024 amending the cybercrime law of 3 July 2019.
facts.system: Law of 3 July 2019 on cybercrime, amended by Ordinance 2024-28

NER.note: Document announces prison terms for online defamation, a law placing nothing until someone is charged; no charge is reported.
